neighbours.label: ' let' in 'let alone' (the position right before 'alone')
fire: He can barely boil an egg, let alone cook a full dinner.
Most people never visit the capital, let alone the remote islands.
The team could not win a single match, let alone the championship.
I can't afford a bicycle, let alone a car.
She had never seen snow, let alone skied down a mountain.
They didn't finish the first chapter, let alone the whole book.
Few of us could name the planets, let alone their moons.
The old printer can't scan, let alone print in colour.
quiet: He can barely boil an egg, so let me cook the dinner.
Most people never visit the capital; let them choose the islands.
The coach would not let the team play the championship match.
I can't afford a bicycle, so my parents let me borrow theirs.
She had never seen snow, so her parents let her ski all day.
They didn't finish the chapter, so the teacher let them stay late.
Few of us could name the planets, so let us review them.
The old printer can't scan, but let it print the report.

notes: card: ' let' x16 of top 32, plus 'AL'(ONE), Stand-Al(one), 'estoy' (solo); output promotes Al/sol/single/only
